title: Configured option values stay data at the process boundary

context.hint: Check that a tool passes external values as data when it starts a helper process.
context.surface: A desktop analysis tool starts a helper using values derived from a supplied file and user-configured options.
assumptions: Imported metadata and configured option values can vary independently.
The helper interface has a defined argument boundary.

review.invariant: Configurable values cannot change how the helper invocation is interpreted.
review.verification: Assert separately that user-configured option values remain data and that a supported configuration can still launch the intended helper.

source_observation.summary: A separate option-value check produced an unintended side effect with the old construction in the harness. The revised construction avoided it, and the ordinary control still completed. The source-project tests were not run.
